phase2_added_source_and_test_files.review_note: Additive transfer journal and invoice composite FK index; exact historical schema migration fixtures validate Room schema.
Durable request, FK restrict and unique active company slot; confirm retains row and frees slot atomically.
Owner routing and strict integer expiry; no local signature/revocation claims; coroutine timer cancellation tested.
Composition lifecycle observer and expiry coroutine; account unmount on expiry/resume, device lifecycle testing still pending.
Fixed authenticated HTTPS origin, no redirect/cache, bounded reply and explicit POST length; FakeHttpURLConnection regression.
Strict integer balance/boolean proof, error rejection and exact UUID/amount receipt checks; malformed reply regressions.
Room reservation before HTTP, immutable amount/owner/request, retain confirmed rows; file-backed SQLite concurrency and injected rollback tests.
Pure geometry matching A4 row/totals/signature/footer positions; bounded layout tests, no native raster certification.
Creates exact committed schema 2/7/8/9 with identity hash and relational data, upgrades to 10, verifies FK/data/trigger/finalization.
Strict expiry/owner, deadline monitor, cancellation and reject financial gateway calls before HTTP for invalid token.
Fake connection validates endpoint, headers, fixed length, resource closure, non2xx and oversized/injected replies without network.
Malformed types, flags, negative/large balances, error fields and mismatched receipt identity/amount.
Native file-backed SQLite reservation/reopen, exact receipt, stale SavedState, concurrency and failed insert/update rollback.
Every supported row count 1..14: no totals/signature/footer overlap and page bounds.

Bounded taxpayer/amount and canonical UUID; original server RPC payloads over shared hardened transport, typed consumption proof.
